fr_html: Mais, Lord Phillimore propose qu'on examine d'abord l'amendement de M. Ricci-Busatti et que, si cet amendement n'est pas adopté, on prenne en considération la proposition de M. de Lapradelle.
en_html: Lord Phillimore, however, proposed that they should first of all consider M. Ricci-Busatti's amendment; if this amendment were not adopted, they could then consider M. de Lapradelle's proposal.
